title: Ontario: Investigators clear police in shooting death of driver: [National Edition]
article: Investigators have decided two Toronto police officers were justified when they shot and killed a man who drove a stolen Jeep at an officer after they had stopped it for a routine check.
The Special Investigations Unit found Constables Paul Lentsch and Bob Grewal were legally justified when they shot at John Menga on February 1, 2002.
